test_isolation._comment: IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY.md §7.1 — declares how AI-written specs get a clean slate, instead of every role file hardcoding a specific reset endpoint. dummy-app uses 'reset_endpoint'; a real app without one would need 'self_contained' (each test creates and cleans up its own uniquely-marked data) or 'external_seed' (a dedicated test environment reset out-of-band, not per-test).

auth._comment: IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY.md §7.2 — declares how a spec establishes a logged-in session, instead of role files hardcoding testids/routes. dummy-app uses 'form_login'. A real app behind external SSO (e.g. Keycloak) would need a 'storage_state' strategy instead (log in once out-of-band, reuse a saved Playwright storageState — see §4.2/§7.2's 'hard rule': never fall back to crawling/testing whatever page a failed or missing session lands on).

test_credentials._comment: Fine as literal values for dummy-app's own fixture data (already public, visible in its committed specs). A real project should point these at env var names instead, not commit real credentials here.

_component_test_app_root_comment: IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY.md §2.3 — Stage 3, the component-test track. Unlike every other path here, component_test_app_root below is absolute: the target (finbook-web-application) is a sibling repo outside QAWorkflowClaudeCode, not something living inside app_root/dummy-app.
_crawl_comment: IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY.md §4/Stage 7 — the browser-based locator crawler (control-plane/crawl.js). base_url is where the app is actually served (server.js's real port); crawl_pages is the explicit page list the plan calls for (~10 lines, not derived from a router parser). Parameterized detail routes (/items/:id etc.) are deliberately excluded from this first pass — see IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY.md's Stage 7 writeup for why.
_route_source_files_comment: IMPLEMENTATION_STRATEGY.md §5/§6/Stage 8 — the 'declare it in config' impact map, deliberately NOT a dependency-graph tool (graphify was considered and rejected — see §5). Coarse and per-route, not per-element: a case touching a shared component (Header.tsx) maps to every route that imports it, same as a real import graph would resolve, without needing one. Unmapped changed files must fail open (§6's safety rails) — not implemented as a gate yet, since selection itself isn't switched on (§6: 'why not switch on selective test runs yet').
